name: gleba-cold-storage
title: Gleba Cold Storage
author: mpodreshetnikov
description: Fridges for Space Age that slow spoilage without removing the challenge. Cold chambers need water and vent steam that has to go somewhere; cryo vaults are cold for free on Aquilo and run on Aquilo-charged cryo cells everywhere else; refrigerated wagons run off their equipment grid; a cryo press seals food in ice blocks for the trip between planets.
